# Written Authorization and Rules of Engagement — Template

**Engagement ID:** [ID]

**Legal customer / owner:** [Organization]

**Authorized signatory (name, role, authority):** [Name and role]

**Operator / pentest provider:** [Business legal name]

**Permitted UTC start/end:** [ISO 8601 times]

**Exact assets:** [FQDNs/IPs and environment; no assumed wildcards]

**Excluded assets and third parties:** [Identity providers, payment gateways, CDNs, other vendors]

**Permitted methods:** [Specify non-destructive tests; live exploit validation requires separate written approval]

**Prohibited methods:** Destructive changes, denial-of-service, credential spraying, persistence, data exfiltration, privilege escalation beyond explicitly approved test accounts, and pivoting to other systems unless separately authorized.

**Test accounts / data handling:** [Who provisions, what data may be accessed, what to do if personal data is encountered]

**Request ceilings and change windows:** [Requests per second, concurrency and blackouts]

**Emergency stop:** [24/7 contact and method; stop on revocation, outage or scope ambiguity]

**Reporting and confidentiality:** [Approved secure delivery method, retention period, redaction and incident escalation]

**Liability and applicable law:** [Agreement / counsel review]

I confirm I am authorized to grant the permissions above on behalf of the system owner. I can withdraw approval at any time. No third-party service is included unless that third party separately authorizes it.

**Authorized signatory:** ____________________  **Date:** __________

**Provider acceptance:** ____________________  **Date:** __________

This template is an operational starting point, not legal advice or an executed agreement.
